# Action Global News

> A business and technology publication covering applied AI, global ecommerce,
> immersive commerce and small business operations. Published from Denver, Colorado.
> Written for operators — owners and managers who make buying decisions themselves.

## About this publication

Action Global News publishes two clearly separated kinds of content:

1. **Original reporting and analysis** carrying an Action Global News byline. Where we
   have a commercial relationship with a company we write about, or where we operate
   the product being covered, that is disclosed in the body of the article near the top.
2. **Aggregated headlines** from other newsrooms' public syndication feeds. These display
   the headline and publication time only, and link directly to the originating publisher.
   We do not reproduce third-party article text.

Editorial standards, sourcing rules, disclosure practice and corrections policy:
https://actionglobalnews.com/editorial-standards/

## Articles

- [The world's first walk-in VR shopping mall opens its doors](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/world-vr-mall-launch/):
  Launch report on World VR Mall, a browser-based three-dimensional shopping concourse where
  storefronts route through to merchants' own ecommerce checkouts. Covers the discovery problem
  in online retail, why headset-optional design matters, progressive scene loading, and the
  conditions under which immersive commerce succeeds or fails. Publisher-operated product;
  disclosed in article.

- [A browser-based flight simulator aimed at student pilots launches without a download](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/vr-flight-simulator-launch/):
  Launch report on VR Flying Simulator. Covers procedural rehearsal for student pilots —
  checklist discipline, instrument scan, navigation tracking — and states explicitly what a
  browser simulator cannot do: it is not an approved training device, logs no hours, and does
  not teach control feel. Publisher-operated product; disclosed in article.

- [Conversational AI has quietly become table stakes for small business websites](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/conversational-ai-small-business/):
  Analysis of what separates conversational assistants that last from those switched off in
  week three: enforced scope, visible escalation paths, grounding in the business's own
  content, and disclosure that the assistant is software. Includes a comparison of deployment
  patterns and caution on agentic systems.

- [The press release didn't die. It got rebuilt for machines that read](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/press-release-ai-search/):
  Analysis of why wire distribution collapsed as an SEO tactic while the press release format
  — dated, attributed, factual, entity-clear — turns out to suit machine retrieval. Covers
  writing the opening passage to stand alone, replacing adjectives with verifiable facts,
  structured markup, and why link-buying through announcements remains dead.

- [The quiet distribution channel: what happens inside local buy-sell groups](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/local-groups-distribution/):
  Analysis of community commerce networks: why trust density rather than membership size
  drives their value, how commercial posting degrades them, why moderation capacity is the
  binding constraint, and why the channel measures poorly and is therefore undervalued.
  Publisher administers such groups; disclosed in article.

- [Marketing inside the most scrutinised category in medicine](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/glp1-telehealth-marketing/):
  Case study on compliant patient acquisition in weight-management telehealth. Covers which
  advertising channels close, what remains available, the three-question claim review process,
  and why constraints that force factual specificity produce better-qualified enquiries.
  Client relationship disclosed in article. Contains no medical claims or advice.

## Sections

- [Technology](https://actionglobalnews.com/technology/): Applied AI and agentic systems,
  search and retrieval, browser and WebGL capability, simulation, small-business deployment.
- [Business & Markets](https://actionglobalnews.com/business/): Rates, credit and inflation
  translated for operators; margin, pricing and cash conversion; home services and the trades.
- [Global Ecommerce](https://actionglobalnews.com/global-ecommerce/): Cross-border payments
  and settlement, duties and landed cost, returns and reverse logistics, marketplace economics.
- [Immersive](https://actionglobalnews.com/immersive/): Browser 3D, spatial commerce,
  simulation and procedural training, spatial interface design.
- [Small Business](https://actionglobalnews.com/small-business/): Local search and entity
  consistency, pricing and cash conversion, community distribution, practical automation.
- [Arts & Design](https://actionglobalnews.com/arts/): Pricing original work, editions and
  licensing, brand identity for small companies, gallery economics, craft and reclaimed trades.
- [Outdoors](https://actionglobalnews.com/outdoors/): Public lands access and permits,
  guiding and outfitting economics, conservation funding, Mountain West regional coverage.
- [World](https://actionglobalnews.com/world/): Aggregation desk. International headlines
  from the BBC, NPR, Al Jazeera and wire coverage. No original international reporting.
- [Video](https://actionglobalnews.com/video/): Video briefings, embedded through each
  platform's own player.

## Working with the publication

- [Advertise](https://actionglobalnews.com/advertise/): Display (two placements per page,
  capped), sponsored editorial with permanent labelling, section sponsorship, announcement
  placement. Advertisers receive no editorial input or advance notice of coverage.
- [Announcements & Submissions](https://actionglobalnews.com/press-releases/): Paid
  announcement placement, permanently labelled, published at a canonical URL with structured
  data. Categories declined are listed. Links in paid announcements carry sponsored attributes.
- [Send a News Tip](https://actionglobalnews.com/news-tips/): Free editorial route. Story
  tips, company announcements and corrections.

- [Editorial Standards & Corrections](https://actionglobalnews.com/editorial-standards/)

- [Terms of Use](https://actionglobalnews.com/terms/): Free to read; quote with attribution
  and a link; ask before republishing in full.
